violation_type.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §747.2105(c)(4))
violation_type.short_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times
violation_type.typical_finding: Children were observed watching Television while eating and drinking their bottles.

finding_variants.text: Children were observed watching Television while eating and drinking their bottles.
During nap time children were observed watching a movie.    Noted: this was corrected at inspection and pictures were taken.
The children were laying on their cots, with the lights off, and the television on.

During the walk through screen time activity was observed during a meal and nap time preparation period. This was corrected during the inspection when the provider turned the television to a black screen lullaby.
During the inspection screen time was being used while children were eating lunch.
A movie was observed playing during naptime.     Note: This was corrected at inspection as the television was turned off.
